notes.title: Bug Fix - August 22, 2023
notes.notes:
Bug fixes and convenience adjustments have been made.

1. Applied stability patches to the Steam Cloud system.
2. Corrected intermittent issue where guided missiles wouldn't periodically fly at the beginning of Adventure 06 map.
3. Modified specific section of Adventure 06 map where falling was not intended, ensuring non-fall behavior.
4. Adjusted instances of sporadic lateral flight while using the trampoline.
5. Altered the swap speed during unmanipulated pages of the ending sketch scene, preventing overly rapid progression.
6. Adjusted gambling den's winning multiplier from 2x to 3x and included a record of winnings on the final result page.

notes.notes:

notes.title: Bug fixes - April 8th, 2023
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43156896/f4db8e64cd2f3cf3447cbe31fdc999260b7aacd6.png[/img]

1. Fixed the issue where the menu graphics settings were reset when the game was closed and reopened.
    (As a result of fixing this bug, the menu may be reset to its default settings.)

2. Fixed the issue where the bicycle view was not fixed forward when manipulating the bicycle on the course. 
    (The top and bottom of the camera can still be manipulated.)

3. Updated the memorial space (tomb) in the village for those who have not yet been added.

4. Changed it so that costumes are not reset when starting a new game.

->Currently, the cause of frame drops in the first village map or specific sections has mostly been identified, and we plan to proceed as quickly as possible in a systematic manner. We are also continuously fixing other bugs and planning updates, such as allowing players who have cleared the game before to choose old stages or adding siege battles. We will continue to work harder for a better game. Thank you.

notes.title: Bug Hotfix - April 3rd, 2023
notes.notes: The item and costume loading process includes retrieving old information, which can cause a reset situation. A hotfix is scheduled to address this issue. The storage system is otherwise unaffected, and this patch is expected to be completed within one hour.

notes.title: ATLF42 major patch
notes.notes:
After continuously observing the streaming of the game following the Early Access release, we have decided to make significant changes to the direction of the game. We apologize for making such significant changes after the release without conducting extensive testing beforehand. We love this project and want to make it a success. We will update it as quickly as possible (aiming for April 1st, Pacific Standard Time).

We will divide the existing large level into seven smaller areas according to the storyline.
There will be changes to the cannon system and item shops.
Costumes will be obtained from hidden places on the map.
As the levels are divided, the dependence on coins and items will decrease.
The game plan will be changed to allow for quick stage updates in the future.
We promise to provide quick content updates that can compensate for the reduced playtime.
PS. We will create a small commemorative space (a tombstone) for the users and streamers who played the previous version in challenging environments. We will include the names or IDs of those who left Steam reviews and those who played or streamed the game in the comments. Thank you.

notes.title: Bug fixes and patches - March 31st, 2023.
notes.notes:
We adjusted the prices of items in order to balance the difficulty level of the game.

Due to optimization issues with the combat AI characters, we have removed the problematic AIs and completely replaced them. We will continue to work on optimization patches in the future.

Also, we are constantly collecting information on bugs and will continue to release patches to make the game better.

Thank you.
